meals.name: Scrambled Eggs with Oatmeal
instructions: Whisk eggs and scramble in butter over medium heat
Cook oatmeal with almond_milk per packet
Slice banana and serve alongside eggs

meals.name: High-Protein Pancakes
instructions: Blend oats, protein powder, egg, banana, and milk
Cook pancakes on a buttered pan over medium heat
Flip when bubbles form on surface
Serve with sliced banana on top

meals.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer yogurt in a glass or bowl
Top with granola, blueberries, and almonds
Drizzle honey over the top

meals.name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
instructions: Toast bread until golden
Mash avocado and spread on toast
Fry or poach eggs and place on avocado
Season with salt and pepper

meals.name: Cottage Cheese and Fruit Bowl
instructions: Scoop cottage cheese into a bowl
Top with pineapple and walnuts
Drizzle with honey

meals.name: Protein Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend protein powder, banana, spinach, and almond_milk until thick
Pour into a bowl
Top with strawberries, almonds, and chia seeds

meals.name: Protein Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Scramble eggs with black beans
Warm tortillas
Fill tortillas with eggs, salsa, cheese, and yogurt
Roll up and serve

meals.name: Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine oats, protein powder, and almond_milk in a jar
Refrigerate overnight
Top with sliced banana and peanut butter before eating

meals.name: Quinoa Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package
Warm spinach in olive oil
Top quinoa with spinach, fried egg, and sliced avocado

meals.name: Tuna and Egg Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F
Whisk eggs and mix in tuna, spinach, and mayo
Pour into greased muffin tin
Bake for 20 minutes until set

meals.name: Bagel with Cream Cheese
instructions: Toast bagel until golden
Spread cream cheese on both halves
Top one half with almond butter and sliced banana

meals.name: High-Fiber Cereal Bowl
instructions: Pour cereal into a bowl
Add skim milk, blueberries, and walnuts
Serve immediately

meals.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Season and grill chicken breast until cooked
Chop romaine, cucumber, and tomato
Slice chicken and arrange over greens
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice

meals.name: Turkey and Avocado Wrap
instructions: Spread hummus on tortilla
Layer turkey, avocado, tomato, and spinach
Roll tightly and cut in half

meals.name: Tuna Salad Bowl
instructions: Mix tuna with mayonnaise
Cook brown rice per package directions
Arrange rice in bowl with tuna, cucumber, avocado, and spinach

meals.name: Black Bean and Rice Bowl
instructions: Cook rice and warm black beans with corn
Combine in a bowl
Top with avocado, tomato, salsa, and greek yogurt

meals.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Grill seasoned chicken breast
Chop romaine and toss with chicken slices
Add parmesan, drizzle with olive oil and lemon
Top with croutons

meals.name: Hearty Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, celery, and garlic in olive oil
Add diced potato, carrot, and lentils
Cover with water and simmer 30 minutes until lentils are tender

meals.name: Grilled Salmon Quinoa Salad
instructions: Cook quinoa and grill salmon
Combine quinoa with cucumber and edamame
Flake salmon over the top
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon

meals.name: Buffalo Chicken Lettuce Wraps
instructions: Brown ground chicken in a pan
Toss with buffalo sauce
Spoon into romaine leaves
Top with greek yogurt ranch and shredded carrot

meals.name: Chickpea Curry with Rice
instructions: Cook brown rice
Sauté garlic in coconut oil, add curry powder
Add chickpeas and diced tomato, simmer 15 minutes
Stir in spinach until wilted
Serve over rice

meals.name: Mediterranean Chicken Bowl
instructions: Grill seasoned chicken breast
Cook quinoa
Arrange chicken and quinoa in bowl
Top with cucumber, tomato, feta, olives, and olive oil

meals.name: Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Hard boil eggs and chop
Mix with mayonnaise and mustard
Spread onto bread and top with spinach
Close sandwich and serve

meals.name: Protein Shake Meal Replacement
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth
Pour and serve

meals.name: Grilled Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Slice chicken and stir fry in sesame oil until cooked
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot, cook until tender
Add soy sauce and toss
Serve over brown rice

meals.name: Seasoned Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning
Warm tortillas
Fill with beef, black beans, lettuce, salsa, and greek yogurt

meals.name: Baked Salmon with Sweet Potato
instructions: Bake salmon at 400F for 12-15 minutes
Bake sweet potato for 45 minutes until tender
Steam broccoli
Season salmon with lemon and serve together

meals.name: Chicken Breast with Rice and Broccoli
instructions: Season and grill chicken breast
Cook rice per package
Steam broccoli with garlic
Serve together

meals.name: Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini Noodles
instructions: Form turkey into meatballs and bake at 400F for 20 minutes
Spiralize zucchini into noodles
Sauté zucchini with garlic and tomato sauce
Serve meatballs over zoodles and pasta

meals.name: Pork Chop with Sweet Potato
instructions: Season and pan-sear pork chop until cooked through
Bake sweet potato until tender
Sauté green beans with garlic
Serve together

meals.name: Shrimp Scampi with Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta
Sauté shrimp in olive oil and garlic
Add zucchini and cook until tender
Toss with pasta and parmesan, finish with lemon

meals.name: Baked Cod with Quinoa and Vegetables
instructions: Season and bake cod at 400F for 12 minutes
Cook quinoa
Roast asparagus and bell pepper
Serve cod over quinoa with vegetables

meals.name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Slice and sauté chicken with onion and peppers
Season with fajita spices
Warm tortillas
Serve chicken and veggies in tortillas with salsa and greek yogurt

meals.name: Beef and Broccoli with Rice
instructions: Slice sirloin thin and stir fry until browned
Add broccoli and soy sauce
Cook rice
Serve beef and broccoli over rice

meals.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Cut tops off peppers and remove seeds
Brown turkey with rice, beans, and tomato
Stuff peppers with mixture and top with cheese
Bake at 375F for 25 minutes

meals.name: Vegetable Curry with Tofu
instructions: Press and cube tofu, pan-fry until golden
Sauté garlic in coconut oil, add curry and vegetables
Simmer until vegetables are tender
Stir in spinach and serve over rice

meals.name: Greek Yogurt Snack
instructions: Scoop yogurt into a bowl
Top with blueberries and drizzle honey

meals.name: Protein Energy Balls
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl
Roll into 8 balls
Refrigerate for 30 minutes before eating

meals.name: Apple with Almond Butter
instructions: Slice apple
Spread almond butter on slices or dip apple slices

meals.name: Cottage Cheese and Pineapple
instructions: Scoop cottage cheese into a bowl
Top with fresh pineapple chunks
